newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil police clash with state workers seeking pay.
newsitem.headline: Brazil police clash with state workers seeking pay.

text.p: Five Brazilians were injured when riot police in the northeastern state of Alagoas clashed with civil servants, protesting about non-payment of salaries over the past nine months, local Globo television said on Friday.

The disturbances occurred on Thursday in the state's capital of Maceio when public workers met with governor Divaldo Suruagy to demand that at least three of the nine months' outstanding pay checks be paid.
After seven hours of talks ended without result, Globo showed the military police in full riot gear forcefully evicting the civil servants from the meeting room.
Outside the building, police used tear gas to disperse the protestors, one of whom lost three fingers in a cannister explosion, Globo said.
Local military police could not be reached to confirm the reports.
